d:
"Drop the Beat" is an electrifying rap that brings participants together to create an unforgettable experience. With everyone showcasing their unique style and energy, the track becomes a high-energy celebration, blending voices, beats, and camaraderie to embody unity and pure hip-hop joy.
Song Credits
Track Name: Drop the Beat
Written & Performed By: 99side, Dharmik, Pho, Vichaar, K!LLSWITCH, Ghaint Jxtt, Siyaahi, Little Bhatia, Naam Sujal, Ajitesh Bhati, Danish, Devil The Rhymer, Sense, Rajjo, Mad Trip, Lashcurry
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna,
